defect: The fix stops aborting the whole sequence when a template such as {delay=x} yields no actions.
reason: The 'if (autoType.isEmpty()) return false;' logic existed before this change, which only reformatted it and added the missing 'if (inTmpl)' line.

defect: isAvailable() calls getKeyboard(), which allocates an XkbDesc via XkbGetKeyboard, and never frees the result, leaking it.
reason: The leaking call is in the newly added isAvailable(), and the fix frees exactly that keyboard description.

defect: deleteIndex erases m_historyModifications at index.row(), but that list has one element fewer than m_historyEntries, so deleting the last row erases past the end and crashes (and the rest go stale).
reason: The erase line was added by this change, and the fix replaces it with a full recalculation to fix the crash.

defect: The fix resolves placeholders in the entry URL before opening it.
reason: The URL was opened without placeholder resolution before this change as well; the change only switched QUrl() to QUrl::fromUserInput.

defect: The fix replaces a bare use of __GXX_EXPERIMENTAL_CXX0X__ in #if with defined() to silence a -Wundef warning.
reason: An undefined macro evaluates to 0 in #if, so behaviour is correct; the build has no -Werror for -Wundef, so it is only a warning.

defect: updateStylesheet sets 'QLineEdit { background: %1; }' with the %1 placeholder unfilled when not in verify mode or when passwords match, producing an invalid stylesheet.
reason: The template string and the unconditional setStyleSheet were introduced here, and the fix (which names 3b330ee) applies the template only when it is filled.

defect: truncateHistory allocates 'new QList<QByteArray>()' for foundAttachements and never deletes it, leaking on every call.
reason: The heap allocation was added by this change, and the fix replaces it with a stack object.

defect: The fix renames argumentKeys to ArgumentKeys for coding style.
reason: A pure rename for style, with no behavioural defect.

defect: The restart uses QProcess::start(QString) with the application path as one command string, which Qt splits on spaces, so the restart fails when the path contains a space.
reason: The restart code was added here, and the fix replaces it with startDetached(path, {}), which passes the path as the program.

defect: The new MarkdownFormats list contains only 'text/markdown', so Markdown files reported by newer Qt (>= 5.15.18) as 'text/x-web-markdown' are not recognised as Markdown.
reason: The Markdown detection list was introduced by this change and the fix extends it; seeing the gap needs knowledge of Qt's MIME database, not of the code.

defect: Calling toHtmlEscaped() on the title and the plain password before setText on auto-format labels makes text without markup display literally as '&' or '"'.
reason: The escaping was added by this change, and the fix reverts it for the title and password and sets explicit plain/rich text formats instead.

defect: setAllowScreenCapture applies setPreventScreenCapture to every window in qApp->allWindows(), including hidden and non-top-level ones, which creates phantom windows.
reason: The allWindows() loop was added here, and the fix restricts it to visible top-level windows; why that matters depends on the osUtils implementation.

defect: isEmpty() now returns true whenever the edit page is not visible, even when a password was entered, so the database key settings apply an empty password when other key components change.
reason: The changed isEmpty() expression is exactly what the fix replaces; the effect shows only in the callers that build the composite key.

defect: Commenting out parser.process(app) and dispatching on argv[1] means --help and --version are treated as an invalid command name instead of being handled.
reason: The removal of process() and the argv-based dispatch were made here, and the fix restores parsing so that --help and --version are handled.

defect: saveSettings reads the 8-digit radio and the step spin box even when Default or Steam is selected and builds fresh settings, dropping the OTP-url format, so the TOTP settings are saved incorrectly.
reason: The saveSettings logic was introduced in this new file, and the fix (#2671) applies the custom fields only when Custom is checked and preserves the previous settings.

defect: The fix adds KeeOtp format preservation, defaults for missing size/step, and reuse of the previous settings in createSettings.
reason: This change only reformatted code; the parsing and writing behaviour the fix repairs predates it.

defect: The GUI_LaunchAtStartup entries are guarded by #ifdef KEEPASSXC_DIST_FLATPAK in Config.h/.cpp, which do not include config-keepassx.h, so the macro is undefined there and the key is missing or inconsistent across translation units in Flatpak builds.
reason: The #ifdef guard was added by this change, and the fix removes it; that the macro is undefined in this file is seen only from the include lists.

defect: setLayout(m_view->layout()) steals the child DatabaseOpenWidget's layout and reparents its children to the dialog, leaving m_view as an empty widget.
reason: The fix replaces this line with a proper layout holding m_view, but the repository does not show which concrete symptom it caused at the time.

defect: new QAction(icon, text) without a parent argument does not compile with Qt 5.6, where that constructor has no default for the parent.
reason: The code was added here and the project declares Qt >= 5.2 supported, so it breaks the build on a supported configuration; the fix adds the explicit nullptr.

defect: The fix renames the misspelled checkSynatx to checkSyntax.
reason: The misspelling was used consistently in the declaration, the definition and the caller, so it was a naming typo, not a functional defect.

defect: StringField::operator= assigns m_key = m_key and m_value = m_value (self-assignment), so assigned StringFields keep their old or empty contents.
reason: The operator was added by this change, and the fix corrects it to copy from other.

defect: The fix only adjusts coding style (braces, default construction of a QString).
reason: A style-only change with no behaviour difference.

defect: The fix updates test sequences to the new {S:...} custom attribute syntax.
reason: A test change that follows a later change of the auto-type format.

defect: The fix stops replacing the entry's login with the passkey username in prepareEntry.
reason: Substituting the passkey username for the login predates this change (13c88e10); this change only routed the lookup through passkeyUtils.

defect: The fix redesigns the tab-selection slots (selectDatabaseTab with a wrap flag) and changes the per-platform shortcut modifiers.
reason: In this header the fix is an API and feature redesign of the slot declarations, not a repair of a defect in these lines.

defect: sizeHint is derived from sizeHintForColumn, which comes from the delegate's sizeHint, which in turn grows with the list widget's width, creating a feedback loop that keeps resizing the widget.
reason: The width-dependent delegate sizeHint and the new sizeHint computation were added here, and the same-day fix replaces them to stop the resizing bug.

defect: The fix stops an earlier QTimer before creating a new one per entry selection (multiple updateTotp activations) and guards a null m_timer.
reason: The per-selection timer creation that causes #1156 predates this change (1a87e30); the added null check covers a path that is not reachable in practice.

defect: The fix only reorders the includes in this header.
reason: The fix to this file is cosmetic and repairs nothing in its lines.

defect: The DatabaseWidget closeRequest signal is connected to closeDatabase(), which closes the current tab, instead of closeDatabaseFromSender(), which closes the requesting database.
reason: The connect and the unused closeDatabaseFromSender slot were both added here, and the fix switches the connection to the correct slot.

defect: The fix adds an EditRole that returns the raw size and updates the test to the new two-column format.
reason: The model change was intentional and the test simply had to follow it; the EditRole is a feature addition.

defect: lockDatabases returns numLocked == count() after closing tabs for file-less databases, so count() has shrunk and the function reports failure even when all databases were locked.
reason: The return expression was added here, and the fix compares against the count taken before the loop.

defect: The new SearchWaitForEnter config key was added to the enum without a matching entry in Config.cpp's configStrings, so the setting is never saved.
reason: The key was introduced by this change, and the fix adds the missing Config.cpp mapping (and renames the key); the omission shows only in the other file.

defect: The fix makes '[PROTECTED]' translatable and uses an ellipsis character.
reason: These are translation and cosmetic changes, and the [PROTECTED] text was not added by this change.

defect: The fix sorts numeric columns numerically with a custom proxy and sets a default sort order.
reason: The score was stored as a string and sorted lexically before this change too; the change only inserted a default proxy.

defect: markAsModified no longer checks whether modified signals are enabled before starting the modified timer, so modifications while emitting is blocked still emit and cause infinite saving with auto-save.
reason: The removed m_emitModified check is in this change's diff, and the fix restores it as modifiedSignalEnabled(), noting the regression from #6438.

defect: update() hides the password generator and resets the toggle only when there is no group, so switching to another group keeps a stale open generator and shown-password state.
reason: The update() logic was introduced in this new file, and the fix moves the reset outside the branch and also resets the password visibility.

defect: The fix swaps QTemporaryFile for a TemporaryFile proxy so the GUI tests pass on Windows.
reason: This is a test-infrastructure change, not a product defect.

defect: The copy-notes action is enabled based on whether the entry has a URL instead of notes.
reason: The old code already used hasUrl() for the notes action; this refactor only renamed the call and kept the existing bug.

defect: The fix maps proxy indices to source rows when activating entries in a sorted report.
reason: This change did not enable sorting, so index.row() was correct here; the mismatch came with a later commit (c830f85c) that enabled sorting.

defect: The fix maps proxy indices to source rows in the HIBP report's activation and context-menu handlers.
reason: Sorting was not enabled at this commit, so m_rowToEntry[index.row()] was correct here; the defect came when a later commit enabled sorting.
